dct_description_sm: Peat cores were collected in 2023–2025 from 13 permafrost and 7 non-permafrost peatlands in Wapusk National Park and the adjacent Churchill Wildlife Management Area, Manitoba, Canada, to characterize regional peat carbon stocks and Holocene peatland development. At permafrost sites, peat from the active layer was collected in metal boxes, while frozen peat beneath the active layer was retrieved using a SIPRE permafrost corer. None of the permafrost cores contained segregated ice lenses. In non-permafrost peatlands, peat cores were collected in metal boxes because peat thickness did not exceed 51 cm above the mineral soil. The dataset contains measurements of dry bulk density, loss on ignition, organic matter density, and organic carbon density. Organic carbon density was calculated by multiplying organic matter density by 0.5.
dct_subject_sm: Past Global Changes - Carbon in Peat on EArth through Time (PAGES_C-PEAT)
dct_title_s: Bulk density and loss-on-ignition data for peat cores collected in 2023–2025 from the northwestern Hudson Bay Lowlands, Canada
